SELECT p.Admission, MIN(p.Birthday), MAX(p.Birthday), COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday >= '1930-01-01' AND p.Birthday < '1941-01-01'
  AND p.ID IN (SELECT l.ID FROM Laboratory AS l)
GROUP BY p.Admission;

arguments.sql:
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday >= '1930-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1941-01-01'
  AND p.ID IN (SELECT l.ID FROM Laboratory AS l)
LIMIT 1
